We live to dye! If you need to dye anything, or turn it back to normal, just leave it to me!|Aju|AoC}}</ref> are recurring [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Location and Uses==
==={{BotW|-}}===
Hateno Dyes are used by [[Sayge]] in the [[Kochi Dye Shop]] in [[Hateno Village]] to change the color of [[Link]]'s [[Armor]].<ref>{{Cite|Here we go! For 20 rupees total, I'll dye your clothes here to the color of your choosing!|Sayge|BotW}}</ref> If Link pays Sayge 20 [[Rupee]]s and selects five [[Material]] of the same color, Sayge will Hateno Dye Link's current Armor in that color.

{{Noncanon|Start}}

==Trivia==
*The pink-colored dye is referred to as "peach" as a result of a direct translation from the Japanese version.<ref>{{Cite|Peach|N/A|BotW}}</ref><ref>{{Cite|桃|N/A|BotW|lang= ja}}</ref> In the language, the name is derived from the color of peach blossom instead of the pale orange color of peach flesh the English name refers to.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= |author= |title= |url= https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%E6%A1%83%E8%89%B2#Japanese|archive= |published= |retrieved= June 19, 2026|site= |type= }}</ref>
*The recipe for Red Dye made an accidental appearance in the novel ''A Traveler at the Gates of Wisdom'' by {{Wp|John Boyne}} due to the top Google search result for dyeing red clothes linking to the {{BotW|-}} recipe.<ref>{{Cite Web|quote= |author= Jon Porter |published= Aug 3, 2020 |retrieved= August 3, 2020|url= https://www.theverge.com/tldr/2020/8/3/21352299/zelda-breath-of-the-wild-red-clothes-dye-traveler-gates-of-wisdom-john-boyne-google-search-results |title= Zelda recipe appears in serious novel by serious author after rushed Google search |site= The Verge |type= }}</ref>
